## Planned contents

- Reranking, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion as stages with different powers.
- Retrieval-augmented generation and agentic search, evaluated as possible supplementary searches.
- What an inspectable execution trace must show.
- Documented, observed and unknown behaviour kept apart, with every product claim dated.
